name: Agent Performance dashboard shows seeded totals, switches to 1 day, and opens the per-agent Stats tab
description: Sidebar 'Agent Performance' opens /agent-performance on the seeded demo runs (PR #476, relative to seed time, no model call): 30 days shows 8 runs ('7 done', $0.07), switching to 1 day shows 4 runs ('4 done', $0.04) with the Security Reviewer first (11 decisions, 82% accept rate). The Models control on that row expands the model split, and View opens the agent's Stats tab on the same 1-day period with 'Split by model'. Covers AC-44. Every click is preceded by a wait --text on fetched data; no `role link --name` (it fails in CI, see e2e/INSIGHTS.md).
